payload.core_mechanism_summary: 2D DP over days and total skips used; precompute per-day min hours for each possible number of skips, then combine across days with knapsack-like allocation.
payload.rationale: Solution defines dp[i][j] as min hours after i days with j total skips. It iterates days and skips, trying allocations per day. This is classic 2D DP, matching dp_2d_state.
